title: Grasping More-than-Digital Futures
subtitle: A research collective for art, craft, education, culture and technology after digital and AI promises
description: Grasping More-than-Digital Futures is an informal interdisciplinary research collective for art, craft, education, culture and technology after digital and AI promises.
footerTagline: An open, informal, interdisciplinary research collective.

home.lead: We gather scholars, artists, educators, and makers who study how humans make, teach, learn, sense, and imagine with technologies after promises of seamless digital progress and artificial intelligence.
descriptionParagraphs: Grasping More-than-Digital Futures is an informal interdisciplinary research collective for scholars exploring the intersections of art, craft, sloyd, education, technology, culture, and digital transformation.

Our work engages with post-digital education, post-AI pedagogies, sustainable computing, digital craft, embodiment, feminist data sciences, critical artistic research, and more-than-digital ways of knowing and making.
coreInterests: Post-AI pedagogies and critical AI studies
Craft, sloyd, digital materiality, and making
Embodiment, feminist data sciences, and experimental practice

interestCards.title: After Digital Promises
interestCards.text: We ask what education, art, and culture become when digital tools are ordinary, uneven, material, and politically charged.

interestCards.title: Crafted Knowledge
interestCards.text: We treat craft, sloyd, making, touch, repair, and situated practice as serious ways of thinking with technology.

interestCards.title: Critical Technologies
interestCards.text: We study AI, data, platforms, infrastructures, and sustainable computing through feminist, ecological, and cultural lenses.
